statement: Amazon's cloud unit is raising reserved GPU capacity rates in all regions from October 7, 2026, with B300 accelerator rates going to $16.146 per hour from $14.04, a rise of about 15 percent and the fourth straight quarterly increase in 2026.
why: A stated prior rate and a stated increase make this a real price change rather than a static quote, and a fourth consecutive quarterly rise on reserved top-end capacity shows buyers still paying up for scarce accelerator hours.

impact.mechanism: Repeated increases in reserved accelerator rental rates signal demand running ahead of available capacity, which supports further accelerator purchases while raising the compute bill for renters.

evidence.excerpt: B300 accelerator rates increasing to $16.146 per hour from $14.04
bringing year to date increases for H100 and B300 models to between 40% and 75%

confidence.basis: Single aggregator report of a provider price change; the provider's own pricing page was not fetched.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 5.97 -> 16.146 (tol 1%); sources: HuggingNews
